edges.notes: axios.post(import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDINARY_BASE_URL, data, config): an image upload to Cloudinary's API (the base URL is env-only, blank in client/.env.example), not a route in the repo

RTK Query endpoint signIn: builder.mutation({ query: () => ({ url: "/auth/login", method: "POST" }) }) on apiSlice.injectEndpoints. apiSlice's baseQuery is baseQueryWithReauth (client/src/redux/apiSlice.js), a custom base query that passes args to fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_SERVER_BASE_URL }); no in-code fallback, client/.env.example sets http://localhost:5000/api and the server listens on PORT 5000. server/index.js mounts authRoutes at /api/auth; router.route(path).<method>(…) chains, route line = the method call
RTK Query endpoint signUp: { url: "/auth/register", method: "POST" }
RTK Query endpoint logout: { url: "/auth/logout", method: "POST" }
RTK Query endpoint refresh: a builder.mutation, but its query says method: "GET" ({ url: "/auth/refresh" })
RTK Query endpoint getBlog: query returns the string `/blog/${blogId}`, so fetchBaseQuery's default GET. server/index.js mounts blogRoutes at /api/blog
RTK Query endpoint getBlogs: query returns "/blog" (GET); router.route("/") under the /api/blog mount
RTK Query endpoint addBlog: { url: "/blog", method: "POST" }
RTK Query endpoint updateBlog: query's block body returns { url: `/blog/${blogId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint deleteBlog: { url: `/blog/${blogId}`, method: "DELETE" }
RTK Query endpoint commentBlog: { url: `/blog/comment/${blogId}`, method: "PUT" }; two segments after /api/blog, so not PUT /:id
RTK Query endpoint deleteCommentBlog: { url: `/blog/comment/${blogId}/${commentId}`, method: "DELETE" }
RTK Query endpoint getRecipe: query returns `/recipe/${recipeId}` (GET). server/index.js mounts recipeRoutes at /api/recipe
RTK Query endpoint getRecipes: query returns "/recipe" (GET)
RTK Query endpoint addRecipe: { url: "/recipe", method: "POST" }
RTK Query endpoint updateRecipe: { url: `/recipe/${recipeId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint rateRecipe: { url: `/recipe/rate/${recipeId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint deleteRecipe: { url: `/recipe/${recipeId}`, method: "DELETE" }
RTK Query endpoint commentRecipe: { url: `/recipe/comment/${recipeId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint deleteCommentRecipe: { url: `/recipe/comment/${recipeId}/${commentId}`, method: "DELETE" }
RTK Query endpoint toggleFavorite: query ({ recipeId }) returns { url: `/recipe/favorite/${recipeId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint getUsers: query returns "/user" (GET). server/index.js mounts userRoutes at /api/user
RTK Query endpoint updateUser: { url: `/user/${userId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint disableUser: { url: `/user/disable/${userId}`, method: "PUT" }
RTK Query endpoint subscribeUser: { url: `/stripe/create-checkout-session`, method: "POST" }; server/index.js mounts subscriptionRoutes at /api/stripe

baseQueryWithReauth calls the fetchBaseQuery result directly with the string "/auth/refresh" (GET) after a 403, so the path is fixed here. Its other two calls, baseQuery(args, …) on lines 18 and 26, send whatever an endpoint's query returned; those requests are labeled at the endpoints, like a helper whose caller supplies the path
